propositions: Add `commit_and_push_tickets_branch(tracker, *, message, strict=False, author_name=None, author_email=None)` that stages and commits dirty tracker changes under an acquired write lock before delegating to push.

Before staging or committing, reuse `lock.check_no_rebase_in_progress` to guard against rebase/merge-recovery state; strict mode raises `PushDeliveryError` with `merge-recovery-blocked` reason, default mode warns and returns without push.

Lock, staging, and commit failures raise dependency-defined `PushDeliveryError` with named reasons; strict mode raises catchable errors, default mode warns and returns without push while retaining uncommitted content for retry.
Per-commit identity is applied via git `-c user.name=... -c user.email=...` flags; ambient identity is used when omitted, and global/repository config is never mutated.

The entrypoint always delegates to `push_tickets_branch` after optional commit, even when tree is clean but locally-ahead; persistent rejection under strict preserves local commits and raises `PushDeliveryError`.
Direct `push_tickets_branch` remains push-only; new `commit-and-push` CLI action routes all arguments while existing `push` action remains unchanged.
